verdict.rationale: Community evidence says Ollama now uses native MLX on Apple Silicon instead of shelling out to llama.cpp. A hands-on M4 Pro benchmark shows 66.5–84.4 tokens/sec with Ollama's nvfp4/int4 variants versus 30.0 for q4_K_M, which suggests real Apple Silicon acceleration. An older report of slow performance on a MacBook Pro tempers this but predates the MLX change. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Metal/ARM/MLX acceleration, explicit vendor claims about Apple Silicon optimization, and independent confirmation of Metal GPU offload.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get accelerated inference on Apple Silicon via native ARM and Metal optimizations

citations.quote: User benchmark on M4 Pro 48GB: qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q4_K_M eval rate 30.0, nvfp4 66.5, int4 84.4 tokens/sec via 'ollama run' with --verbose.
Ollama was basically shelling out to llama.cpp on mac before, so native mlx should mean better memory handling on apple silicon.
